filters.holdsSearchPlaceholder: XPH code, customer name, shop name

settle.title: Settle booking hold {code}
settle.noteRequired: A reason is required (at least 5 characters).
settle.disputeOpen: This booking still has an open dispute — resolve it before settling the money.
settle.auditHint: This action is written to the audit log and cannot be undone.
settle.confirmHint: The outcome "{outcome}" will be settled and the money allocated right away. The reason is written to the audit log under your name.
settle.notePlaceholder: e.g. the dispute was resolved in the customer's favour, refund in full
settle.chooseHint: Pick an outcome on the right — preview who receives what before settling.
settle.previewEmpty: Choose an outcome to see who receives what.
settle.noAllocation: Legacy hold — this outcome is recorded only; no money is allocated.

outcomeHelp.settled: Trip completed: deposit to the owner (after tax), fee to XePrime, insurance to the insurer.
outcomeHelp.split_late_cancel: Late cancellation or no-show: deposit and fee split between owner and XePrime; insurance refunded to the customer.
outcomeHelp.refunded: Refund the customer everything they transferred.
outcomeHelp.kept: Trip ran: the platform keeps the amount; nothing is transferred.
outcomeHelp.forfeited: Late cancellation or no-show: the amount goes to the shop wallet as compensation.
outcomeHelp.released_to_shop: Trip completed: the amount is returned to the shop wallet.

refundPaid.title: Record refund transfer
refundPaid.noAccount: The customer has not provided a refund account yet — cannot transfer.

reject.title: Reject refund
reject.noteRequired: A reason is required (at least 5 characters).
reject.audienceHint: The customer will read this reason.

reconciliation.varianceHint: The bank balance does not match the two sides. Check the unmatched incoming queue, manual transfers not yet recorded, and the balance you entered.
reconciliation.walletDriftWarning: Ledger drift in {count, plural, one {# wallet} other {# wallets}} · {amount} total
reconciliation.walletDriftHint: Wallet ledger entries do not add up to the stored balance. That means something writes balances outside the ledger — stop payouts and investigate before spending further.

insurance.title: Insurance queue
insurance.loadError: Could not load the insurance queue

partnerMissing.title: No insurance partner configured
partnerMissing.body: Premiums are being collected and held, but no insurer is issuing certificates — customers do NOT actually have cover. Retrying changes nothing until a real partner is connected. This is a platform configuration task, not a per-trip incident.

actions.retryQueued: Retry queued — the worker picks it up within a minute

empty.title: No failing policies
empty.description: Every premium collected has been dealt with.

voidModal.title: Void insurance policy
voidModal.hint: Voiding is a money decision and goes into the audit log. If the certificate was already issued, settle it with the partner first — voiding here only closes the XePrime side.
voidModal.reasonPlaceholder: Why this policy is being voided
voidModal.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for voiding (at least 5 characters).

tax.title: Tax ledger by period
tax.loadError: Could not load the tax ledger

unknownWarning.title: Some obligations belong to shops with no seller profile
unknownWarning.body: Without an entity type there is no way to know which return these rows belong to. Ask those shops to complete their profile before closing the period — do not fold them into the individual bucket, which would be guessing at a legal obligation on their behalf.

empty.title: No obligations in this period
empty.description: Tax only accrues once a trip has started — trips cancelled before pickup have no row.

reverseModal.title: Reverse a tax row
reverseModal.hint: Reversing writes a NEGATIVE row pointing at the original; it never edits the old figure. Afterwards the booking can record the correct obligation again. Remitted rows cannot be reversed — use an amended return.
